ui.original_playback.help: Playback and note positions use this original image. Recognition does not redraw the score. Unmapped notes have no guessed marker.
ui.original_playback.bind_help: Double-click the selected note head on this original page to record its image position.
messages.original_playback.legacy_positi: This older project has original pages but only regenerated-score positions. Original pixels and music are kept; recognize again or bind positions on the original for accurate markers.
cli.original_playback.view_check: Verify original-image clicks, highlights and viewport continuity
cli.original_playback.workflow_check: Verify original-only local recognition, storage and playback
ui.original_playback.drag_help: Correction mode: vertical dragging edits pitch and horizontal dragging edits measure-relative onset, controlled independently. Disable both for position-only edits. Inspector, audition, history and saving stay synchronized; source pixels are unchanged.
ui.original_playback.moved: Image position updated; pitch, duration and original score pixels are unchanged.
ui.original_playback.invalid_anchor: Invalid original-image note position. Keep the complete note frame inside its original page.
cli.original_playback.anchor_check: Verify original-image note dragging, undo and persistence
ui.original_playback.inspector_help: Click a note to edit pitch, measure, onset and duration in the right inspector, then audition, apply or cancel. Ctrl+Z undoes; Alt-click cycles overlaps.
ui.original_playback.add_help: Pitch follows the measured staff, clef and key; onset uses local spacing or a same-beat column, not a fixed page-wide scale. Edit and audition before adding; source pixels stay unchanged.
ui.original_playback.note_added: Note added. Drag its image box to the correct head; Undo is available.
ui.original_playback.note_deleted: Selected note deleted from sound and image selection; Undo is available.
ui.original_playback.edit_help: Correction mode: right-click to add, select and drag a box, or press Delete.
cli.original_playback.note_edit_check: Verify original-image note insertion, deletion, sound and project roundtrip
ui.original_playback.recovery_saved: Edits retained automatically: %1. Ctrl+S saves the project.
ui.original_playback.recovery_failed: Automatic retention failed: %1. Edits remain in the open project; save it.
ui.original_playback.no_recovery: No retained staff edits are available.
ui.original_playback.recovery_loaded: Retained edits restored: %1. Save as a project.
ui.original_playback.position_unknown: No reliable staff or clef at this point. The note is unchanged; use properties or position-only mode.
ui.original_playback.pitch_moved: Pitch and correction symbol updated and auditioned; edits are retained automatically.
cli.original_playback.smart_check: Verify staff position/pitch linking, properties, correction layer, audition and retained edits
ui.original_playback.sidebar_help: Click a note to inspect it. In correction mode, edit, audition and apply. Onset counts from beat 0; one quarter note is 1 beat. Practice mode is read-only.
ui.original_playback.no_selection: Click a note in the original score
ui.original_playback.timing_distance: Local spacing estimate: measure %1, onset %2 beats, duration %3 beats (%4 px from the reference, about %5 beats). Audition and review.
ui.original_playback.timing_chord: Same-beat chord: measure %1, onset %2 beats, suggested duration %3 beats. Vertically stacked notes start together.
ui.original_playback.timing_manual: No reliable local beat calibration here. Enter the measure-relative onset explicitly; a quarter note is 1 beat and onset starts at 0.
ui.original_playback.timing_moved: Measure-relative onset is now %1 beats; pitch, position and sound are synchronized. Duration is unchanged.
ui.original_playback.timing_move_unknown: No reliable beat calibration here, or the move crossed a bar/system. The original note and music were preserved.
